issue.title: Run the Bob Mac Capture link-copy acceptance (⌘Y L ↵) once a released bob ships bob ref links

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-ct.5 (note #2) and recorded by epic bob-cli-ct's land agent.

Run the Mac acceptance from plan:202610/ref_link_copy.md, phase mac-ui, "Acceptance on the Mac". It needs a bob that ships `bob ref links` on the Mac: the next release-train build after v0.3.1, which contains 96793fda, 82716a64, and 42abfa70.

1. On athena, `bob ref create` a fixture report with: a written link and a reference link, an autolink in a Sources list, a bare URL, a mailto, a link wrapping across a page break, a heading link, a repeated URL, a URL with a query and a fragment, and about 30 filler links in later sections.
2. Let the vault sync. Open the PDF in Highlights at a later page.
3. Type `⌘Y L ↵` fast and paste. Compare against `bob ref links <ref> <n>` on athena and against the URL Highlights opens on click.
4. Repeat with a digit, `⌥↵`, `A`, and `⌥A`.
5. Open a backfilled reference (athena recatalog wrote 235 stores) and check that its pages and `●` look right.
6. On a web article with a source URL, check that `L` still copies the Markdown link (l_key = shared), and that Option-U copies the same text.

Report any mismatch as a failure, not a caveat.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-ct closes with this acceptance unverified, as the plan allows ("report the acceptance as unverified rather than skipping silently"). No released bob ships `ref links` yet (latest is v0.3.1), and the steps need interactive Highlights keystrokes on the Mac. Unit tests, portable-check, macOS CI (runs 40403165310 and 40407215560), and the design renders all passed.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ct.5 note #2: epic bob-cli-ct closes with its interactive Mac acceptance unverified because no released bob has ref links yet.
